product_one_liner.notes: The company describes cash automation on its homepage and provides further product and safety details in its FAQ.
product_one_liner.value: Rivo is an automated cash-management service for U.S. consumers that moves eligible idle cash from an existing checking account into short-term U.S. Treasury bills and brings it back around bills and spending needs.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company site does not provide a verifiable full team page or dated leadership join/departure information. The founder profile alone does not establish whether any C-level/VP transition occurred.
